title: Parliamentary constituency dimension row (canonical, period-stable)
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/elections/dim_pcs.parquet. One row per (state_code, delim_year, pc_no). Holds the PC (Lok Sabha) display name and identity fields that election_results.parquet does not carry. PK = pc_id (canonical/adapters/eci/identity.pc_entity_id). The Lok Sabha sibling of dim-acs; pc_id carries state_code for global uniqueness because ECI pc_no is per-state. Period-stable within a delimitation cycle; UPSERT-idempotent across re-runs. Added for the Lok Sabha PC results ingest (TODO/20260531-uk-style-elections-experience-plan.md PR-A2).

x-changelog.description: Initial dim_pcs schema. Columns: pc_id PK, state_code, delim_year, pc_no, name, source_id. Mirrors dim-acs v1.0 with pc_no replacing eci_no and the IN-PC- prefixed id carrying state_code for global uniqueness.

pc_id.description: PK. e.g. 'IN-PC-2008-S22-39' (a Tamil Nadu PC in the 2008 delimitation cycle). Leading IN-PC- prefix lets the national atlas prune with entity_id LIKE 'IN-PC-%'.

state_code.description: ECI state code (e.g. S22 for Tamil Nadu, U05 for Delhi).

delim_year.description: Delimitation cycle year (2008 post-delimitation; pre-2008 PC numbering is not comparable across the 2008 break).

pc_no.description: ECI numeric PC number within the state.

name.description: Display name as printed by ECI (e.g. 'Chennai South'). Nullable when upstream omitted it. The citizen URL slug is derived; this is the canonical label.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet. First-observed source; UPSERT keeps the earliest observation.
